verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes Datadog docs on Sensitive Data Scanner, Audit Trail, and Log Management, but none of these citations describe specific data retention periods, configurable retention windows, or data-deletion/right-to-be-forgotten controls for AI-native users. Since observability platforms plausibly offer such retention/deletion settings, this axis applies, but no evidence demonstrates it, so it is 'none'. Missing for 10: documentation on configurable log/metric retention settings, data deletion or purge APIs, and GDPR/CCPA data-subject deletion workflows.
